children: ProPetro announced PROPWR has entered contracts to commit approximately 230 megawatts of power generation capacity to a Targa Resources subsidiary.
PROPWR signed contracts to commit ~230 MW of behind‑the‑meter power capacity to a Targa subsidiary for the Permian Basin.
Total capacity committed under contract for PROPWR now stands at ~510 MW after the new agreements.
Contracts support Targa’s natural gas processing infrastructure; full deployment expected in early 2028.
Recontracting frees capacity for potential data center deployments in 2027 and beyond.
